For Juicebox Growth - UK

Every ecosystem bet, tied to the accounts it actually produced.

I read the Growth - UK job description. This is where I think the issue is, this is how I have solved it before, and this is how I would solve it for you.

The issue

Ecosystem spend is a black box

VC partnerships, founder dinners, conferences, OOH - the role runs on relationships, but a quarter later nobody can say which initiative produced a customer. The next budget is a guess, and the best channel gets cut with the worst.

Before

How I have solved it

At Corgi I ran product operations and built the internal systems the team worked from. Before that I founded a company and ran its operations end to end, where every pound of spend had to justify itself.

For you

How I would solve it

Track every initiative from first touch to activated account: what it cost, which accounts it sourced, how far they got, and the cost per activated account - so doubling down is a decision, not a debate.

Initiatives in. Accounts out.

Four sample initiatives from a UK growth quarter. Pick one to see the accounts it sourced, how far each one travelled, and the economics. Sample data throughout.
